sentences.japanese: 議長は委員会の始まりを告げた。
sentences.english: The chairman called the committee to order.

sentences.japanese: 真実を告げることをためらってはなりません。
sentences.english: Never hesitate to tell the truth.

sentences.japanese: 雨が一日中降るだろうと彼女は我々に告げた。
sentences.english: She advised us that it would rain all day.

sentences.japanese: 医者は彼は脳死状態だとあなたに告げるのです。
sentences.english: The doctors tell you that he is brain-dead.

sentences.japanese: ラジオは悪天候になると告げた。
sentences.english: The radio gave a warning of bad weather.
